{{Quote|They've kept me healthy and wealthy for years. They watch over gamblers. Protect and profit the risk-takers.|[[Narvusin]]|<ref name="TOR:StP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Shattering the Peace|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
The '''Lords of Chance''' were [[Deity/Legends|deities]] idolized by [[Gambler/Legends|gamblers]]. The Lords of Chance were said to protect the most audacious gamblers and keep them healthy and wealthy.<ref name="TOR:StP" />
